Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for nonpartisan election of prosecuting attorneys.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to election of prosecuting attorneys; and amendingRCW 29A.04.110, 29A.52.111, and 29A.52.231.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.04.110 and 2005 c 2 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Partisan office" means a public office for which a candidate mayindicate a political party preference on his or her declaration ofcandidacy and have that preference appear on the primary and generalelection ballot in conjunction with his or her name. The following arepartisan offices: (1) United States senator and United States representative; (2) All state offices, including legislative, except (a) judicialoffices; and (b) the office of superintendent of public instruction; (3) All county offices except (a) judicial offices ((and)); (b) theprosecuting attorney; and (c) those offices for which a county homerule charter provides otherwise.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.52.111 and 2004 c 271 s 173 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Candidates for the following offices shall be nominated at partisanprimaries held pursuant to the provisions of this chapter: (1) Congressional offices; (2) All state offices except (a) judicial offices; and (b) theoffice of superintendent of public instruction; (3) All county offices except (a) judicial offices ((and)); (b) theprosecuting attorney; and (c) those offices where a county home rulecharter provides otherwise.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29A.52.231 and 2004 c 271 s 174 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The offices of superintendent of public instruction, justice of thesupreme court, judge of the court of appeals, judge of the superiorcourt, ((and)) judge of the district court, and prosecuting attorneyshall be nonpartisan and the candidates therefor shall be nominated andelected as such. All city, town, and special purpose district elective offices shallbe nonpartisan and the candidates therefor shall be nominated andelected as such.
